title: It is very sturdy once it is put together
text: It is very sturdy once it is put together. These are a little awkward to assemble but no tools are needed, that's a plus.  It is very sturdy once it is put together, rolls smoothly.  It comes in handy in the laundry room to hang dry clothes or lay flat on top to flat dry.  Great when you have a guest over and want to give them a place to hang their clothes without them putting them in your closet.
